news.summary: James Bowen is the latest jockey to confirm he has received death threats from angry punters, revealing both he and brother Sean needed extra protection after an incident last year.
news.title: Bowen brothers needed extra protection after threats

news.summary: Paul Nicholls surpasses Martin Pipe to set a new National Hunt record for winners by a British trainer.
news.title: Nicholls sets record for jump winners by British trainer

news.summary: Jockey Nico de Boinville is given extra security support at Plumpton racecourse after being the subject of a threat.
news.title: De Boinville given extra security at Plumpton after threat

news.summary: The remains of a top Australian racehorse that died of colic on Monday were found at a public rubbish tip.
news.title: Body of Melbourne Cup horse found dumped in Sydney skip

news.summary: Jockey Harry Cobden rides Meetmebythesea to a first Paddy Power Gold Cup success for owner JP McManus at Cheltenham.
news.title: Meetmebythesea wins first Paddy Power Gold Cup for McManus

news.summary: BBC Midlands Today meets Warwickshire's Dan Skelton, the prolific champion jumps trainer already on course to do it again.
news.title: Champion trainer Skelton happy but always wanting more

news.summary: Ludlow is forced to cancel the entire 2026-27 season following the damage done to the Shropshire racecourse by the summer drought.
news.title: Drought-hit Ludlow forced to cancel 2026-27 season

news.summary: Tom O'Brien, the nephew of trainer Aidan, rode more than 1,000 winners and won the Welsh Grand National twice.
news.title: Jockey O'Brien dies aged 39

news.summary: Australian jockey Izzy Neale passes away following a fall during a race in Australia on Sunday.
news.title: Jockey Neale, 22, dies after fall during race

news.summary: Point of Law ridden by Ethan Brown has won Australia's "race that stops a nation".
news.title: Horse sold by King Charles wins Melbourne Cup

news.summary: Wales' highest-rated horse, Haiti Couleurs, storms to first Grade 1 win in the Remembering Envoi Allen Champion Chase at Down Royal in Lisburn.
news.title: Haiti Couleurs storms to first Grade 1 victory
